abstract.p: This paper describes our approach to the SemEval-2025 Task 7: Multilingual and Crosslingual Fact-Checked Claim Retrieval on both the monolingual and crosslingual tracks. Our training methodology for text embedding models combines contrastive pre-training and hard negatives mining in order to fine-tune models from the E5 family. Additionally, we introduce a novel approach for merging the results from multiple models by finding the best majority vote weighted configuration for each subtask using the validation dataset. Our team ranked 6 th in the monolingual track scoring a 0.934 S@10 averaged over all languages and achieved a 0.79 S@10 on the crosslingual task, ranking 8 th in this track.
